text:
emma: Heads-up: EdgeScale asked for a polished phone-bridge + escalation playbook we can hand to their NOC. Need this trimmed to one Slack-pinned doc + a one-page PDF for their oncall.

raj: Drafting a phone-first flow. Key ask from partners: who calls whom, fallback numbers, and a short call script. Will post template in 30m.

linh: Can we include SI contacts (SysInt partners) and marketplace ops? They sometimes need an early heads-up for listing impacts.

maria: Yes, marketplace ops should get an automated DM on SEV1. I'll write the marketplace notice snippet.

tom: From eng-side, we need clear ownership windows: 0-15m triage, 15-60m mitigation, 60+m engineering investigation.

liz: EdgeScale preference: a single shared war room channel (private) + Zoom bridge. They want phone escalation list for 3 timezones.

emma: OK, rough playbook below. Please comment inline. If no objections, I'll pin and export to runbook.

emma: ```
PARTNER PHONE-BRIDGE PLAYBOOK  EdgeScale

1) SEV1 - Immediate (0-15m)
- Post brief symptom in #partners-edgescale (include region, sample error, last-known-good).
- Auto-notify: @eng-oncall, @ops-bot, marketplace-ops DM via automation.
- If confirm production impact -> trigger PagerDuty "partner-edgescale-sev" and call phone bridge.

Phone bridge steps (caller):
- Dial: +1-555-720-2000 (Redwood oncall conduit)
- Enter PD conference pin (automated by PD integration)
- Read short script: "This is Redwood. Incident affecting EdgeScale customers in <region>. Symptom: <one-line>. Triage started at <ts>."

2) War room (15-30m)
- Auto-create private channel: #ps-edgescale-sev1-<ts> (ops-bot creates).
- Invite: partner SRE, @liz, @eng-oncall, @linh, @maria, SI lead, legal if PII implicated.
- Start Zoom via deploy-bot template.

3) Escalation matrix
- 0-15m: Redwood triage + partner NOC
- 15-60m: Redwood oncall becomes incident lead
- 60m+: Senior eng oncall takeover; if >4h, schedule executive brief.

4) Comms & marketplace notice
- Marketplace holding message (CSM drafts, legal approves before public status).
- Example: "We're aware of an issue impacting EdgeScale customers in <region>. We're investigating and will update in 30 minutes."

5) SI & HW partner steps
- If hardware suspected, partner HW lead coordinates on-site/firmware actions.
- SI integrators join war room and post confirmed scope.

6) Post-incident
- Joint postmortem within 72h. Include runbook updates and PD playbook test results.
```

incident-bot: Created PD service "partner-edgescale-sev" (id: svc_az12). Remember to store integration keys in secrets manager.

ops-bot: Auto-creator enabled for #ps-edgescale-sev1-<ts> when PD status = acknowledged. Zoom template: zoom.link/ps-edgescale.

raj: Two action items: I'll add PagerDuty escalation policy and test dial-in flow. Also will add timezone fallbacks for EMEA/APAC numbers.

linh: I'll draft SI contact block + include a CSV with phone numbers for handoff.

maria: I'll provide marketplace notice templates and the legal checklist for visibility.

liz: EdgeScale confirms they will provide an on-call rotation CSV and prefer Redwood to initiate the first call on SEV1s.

emma: Great. Let's run a 20-min DRY-RUN Thursday 09:00 PT in #partners-edgescale. Ops-bot schedule?

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1792243200: DRY-RUN Thursday 09:00 PT in #partners-edgescale. :white_check_mark:

emma: Thanks everyone. After dry-run I'll export the one-pager PDF and share with EdgeScale and SI leads.
